about: Asset slot contract. Pages ask for a slot id through resolve.js and never name a file or a provider. Every slot must be filled by the builtin provider; other providers may fill any subset. 'accepts' lists the forms a provider may supply, in the resolver's preference order. Assets carry identity and atmosphere only: no diagram, label or data is ever baked into an asset.

Icon for TickerTalk, the news app with 400,000 readers
Icon for Brightwater, the broker partner whose sandbox runs paper trades
Icon for Quoteline, the delayed market-data provider
